0.0: We are now prepared for battle. All the intelligence you have gathered and all the efforts of our troops have led to this.
0.1: We can only win this battle if everyone does their best. Now, your role will be the bait.
0.2: Fight the Specters head-on, and pretend to lose and retreat so that they chase you. You must lure them to the valley area!
0.3: This will be a crucial battle. We must be absolutely prepared before departing.
0.4: Are you ready for the fight of your life?

no.0: Well, do what you have to do and ready up. We don't have time to waste.
